Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Conroe, Texas, I found two vehicles in the roadway. Driver 1
reported that the vehicle was turning left when it was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle had been traveling straight
through. Driver 1 stated having neck and back strain following the impact. The described injuries are consistent with
the force of a collision of this type. Driver 1 is listed as the named dirver on the insurance policy for the vehicle
involved. Driver 1 and the Passenger were both seated in the vehicle at the time of impact, and I confirmed their
presence on scene. No independent witnesses were located. Scene photographs taken by responding officers show
damage to the left side of Driver 1's vehicle and the front of Driver 2's vehicle, which matches the reported imapct
point. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to this department. Both drivers were advised of the reporting
requirements, and the vehicles were cleared from the roadway without further incident.
</page>
